intro_text.en: Unit 5 of Engineering Materials Science: the surface, and the five ways it is defended. It starts from why a part fails at the surface, then works through cleaning and mechanical finishing, electroplating and electroless plating, anodising, phosphate and chromate conversion coatings, electropolishing and photo-etching, and PVD and CVD thin films. Oils follow with viscosity, the viscosity index, additives and the designation of a drum; paints and varnishes as a system of coats over a blasted plate; and corrosion as an electrochemical cell with six shapes and one defence each. Six solved numericals follow in section 5.6.

title.en: 5.1 Surface engineering, cleaning and mechanical finishing
title.gu: 5.1 Surface engineering, સફાઈ અને mechanical finishing

h.en: The surface is a different material
h.gu: સપાટી એ જુદી જ સામગ્રી છે

body.en:
Almost nothing fails in the middle of a part. Wear, fretting, fatigue, pitting and corrosion all begin in the first few micrometres, because that is where the highest stress, the environment and the relative motion all meet. Surface engineering is the deliberate control of that zone: a hard film on a tough core for wear, a barrier for corrosion, a compressive skin for fatigue, a low-friction layer for sliding. The core keeps the load and the surface takes the attack.

Why it is true. the stress is highest at the surface, the environment touches only the surface, and two sliding parts meet only at the surface - so a treatment that changes the top 20 micrometres changes the life of the part while the chemistry of the core stays cheap and tough.

Common mistake. a coating is not a repair. Plating or painting over a fatigue crack hides it, and the crack keeps growing under the paint until the part breaks; the surface is treated before it is damaged, not after.

Check your answer. ask what is killing the part - abrasion, rust, alternating load or friction - and only then choose the millimetres. A 20 micron nitride on a part that is actually corroding is money spent on the wrong failure.

h.en: Cleaning and mechanical finishing: the roughness you buy
h.gu: સફાઈ અને mechanical finishing: કઈ ખરબચડાઈ ખરીદો છો

body.en:
No coating works on a dirty surface, so the order is fixed: degrease with an alkali or a solvent, pickle in acid to remove scale and rust, blast to a controlled profile, and coat within a few hours before the steel re-rusts. Mechanical finishing comes in the same ladder everywhere: turning at about 3.2 micron Ra, grinding at 0.8, honing at 0.2, lapping at 0.05. Each step costs roughly three times the last and buys about half the roughness, so the drawing asks for the finish the function needs and no finer.

theoretical roughness of a turned surface: Ra = f^2/(32 r) feed f = 0.20 mm/rev, tool nose radius r = 0.8 mm Ra = 0.04/(32 x 0.8) = 0.00156 mm = 1.56 micron halve the feed to 0.10 mm/rev: Ra = 0.01/25.6 = 0.39 micron, a quarter

Why it is true. the finish is geometry, not magic: a round tool nose of radius r leaves a scallop every feed, and the depth of that scallop is f squared over 8r, so the feed matters twice as much as the tool radius. It also explains why a plating copies the profile it grows on - a bright plating on a torn surface is a bright torn surface.

Common mistake. blasting is not free either. On a part that lives in fatigue, a coarse blast raises the stress at the bottoms of the pits it makes; the same treatment that helps a painted structure can shorten the life of a spring.

Check your answer. write the finish as a number on the drawing, not as 'smooth'. Ra 0.8 with a 50 - 75 micron blast profile and Sa 2 1/2 is a specification; 'well finished' is not.

title.en: 5.2 Metallic coatings, conversion coatings and thin films
title.gu: 5.2 Metallic coatings, conversion coatings અને thin films

body.en:
In electroplating the work is the cathode in a bath of the coating metal's own salt, and a plate of that metal is the anode. Metal dissolves from the anode, crosses the electrolyte as an ion and is deposited on the work, so the bath keeps its composition and only the addition agents decide whether the deposit is bright or dull, hard or soft. Electroless plating (nickel with sodium hypophosphite) needs no current, so it covers a complex shape evenly. Anodising does not add a metal: it grows the aluminium's own oxide, 5 - 25 micron thick, which is hard, insulating and porous enough to take a dye.

Faraday: m = M I t/(n F), with F = 96500 C/mol per ampere-hour: 58.7/(2 x 96500) x 3600 = 1.095 g of nickel thickness t = M i t_sec eta/(n F rho); i = 300 A/m2, eta = 0.95, 20 min t = (58.7e-3 x 300 x 1200 x 0.95)/(2 x 96500 x 8900) = 11.7e-6 m = 11.7 micron

Why it is true. Faraday's law is counting atoms. Every 96500 coulomb liberates one mole of electrons, and a nickel ion needs two of them, so a coulomb always deposits the same 0.304 mg of nickel - the only variables left are the current, the time and how much of the current is wasted on hydrogen.

Common mistake. plating does not fill a scratch and it does not make a part stronger. Worse, hydrogen from the plating bath enters a hardened steel and embrittles it, so a plated high strength part must be baked at about 200 C within a few hours.

Check your answer. say which mechanism you are buying: zinc protects by corroding itself, nickel and chrome protect only by sealing the steel off, and anodising changes the metal rather than covering it. A barrier that is scratched is a barrier that has failed.

h.en: Conversion coatings, electropolishing and thin films
h.gu: Conversion coatings, electropolishing અને thin films

body.en:
A conversion coating has no interface to peel, because the surface is turned into the coating: phosphating grows a 2 - 10 micron crystalline zinc or iron phosphate that keys paint and holds oil, chromating passivates zinc, and bluing grows the 1 - 3 micron oxide on a gun. Electropolishing is the reverse of plating - the work is the anode and the surface is dissolved away, 10 - 50 micron, leaving a bright, burr-free, hygienic face. Photo-etching uses the same dissolution through a resist to cut a pattern.

thin films: PVD 0.1 - 5 micron, CVD 5 - 20 micron PVD TiN at 480 C: 2500 HV, line of sight, so the fixture turns CVD at 1000 C: better throwing power and adhesion, but the substrate must take the heat one 3 micron TiN coating on an insert: Rs 8 extra, 3 times the tool life 20 parts/insert at Rs 60 = Rs 3.00 per part; 60 parts at Rs 68 = Rs 1.13 per part

Why it is true. a conversion coating cannot peel because there is nothing to peel - the boundary between coating and metal has been dissolved into a gradient. A thin film is the opposite: it is an added layer, so its adhesion is a real number and a warm substrate, a clean surface and a rotating fixture are what buy it.

Common mistake. an anodised surface is an insulator and a sponge. If it is not sealed in boiling water or a cold sealant, the dye bleeds out in service and the open pores become the start of a pitting cell.

h.en: What an oil does, and the four numbers that describe it
h.gu: તેલ શું કરે, અને તેને વર્ણવતા ચાર આંકડા

body.en:
An oil does four jobs at once: it separates the surfaces so that metal never touches metal, it carries heat away, it carries dirt to the filter, and it keeps oxygen and water off the metal. The property that does the first job is viscosity, and it is the hardest one to hold, because an oil that is 68 cSt at 40 C is about 10 cSt at 100 C and 300 cSt at 30 C - the same oil, one fluid, a thirty-fold change. The viscosity index measures how little of that change a particular oil suffers, and the pour point and flash point mark the two ends of its useful life.

Common mistake. thicker is not safer. An oil that is too thick cannot reach the bearing clearance on a cold start, so the machine runs dry for the first seconds; an oil that is too thin lets the asperities touch at running temperature. The grade is chosen at the running temperature, not at the drum.

title.en: 5.5 Corrosion: why it happens and what it looks like
title.gu: 5.5 કાટ: કેમ થાય અને કેવો દેખાય

h.en: Corrosion is a cell, and the cell needs four things
h.gu: કાટ એક cell છે, અને cell ને ચાર વસ્તુ જોઈએ

body.en:
Corrosion is electrochemical: at one place on the surface iron gives up electrons and dissolves as Fe2+, and at another place oxygen takes those electrons and water turns into hydroxide. The two places are the anode and the cathode, the water film between them is the electrolyte, and the metal is the path. Rust is what happens next: the Fe2+ meets oxygen and water and becomes hydrated iron oxide, which occupies six to seven times the volume of the iron it came from - so a rust layer lifts paint and splits concrete.

h.gu: કાટના છ આકાર, અને દરેક માટે એક બચાવ

The shape of the damage names the mechanism. Uniform attack eats the whole area at the same rate and can be paid for with a corrosion allowance. Galvanic attack happens where two metals touch. Pitting is a local break in a passive film, crevice attack is stagnant liquid under a gasket, intergranular attack follows the grain boundaries of a sensitised stainless steel, and stress corrosion cracking needs a tensile stress and a chloride at the same time. Erosion corrosion is a film that is scrubbed away as fast as it forms.

corrosion allowance = rate x design life 0.25 mm/year over 10 years = 2.5 mm wall: 6.0 mm now, minimum 4.5 mm, so 1.5 mm is available 2.5 mm > 1.5 mm, so plain steel fails life 6; either 7.0 mm wall or a coating

body.en:
Question (7 marks)

A steel panel of 0.5 m2 is to be nickel plated to 20 micron. The current density is 300 A/m2, the cathode efficiency is 95 %, and for nickel M 58.7, n 2 and rho 8.9 g/cm3. Find the current, the mass of nickel needed and the plating time.

Step 1 - the current and the volume

I = i A = 300 x 0.5 = 150 A V = 0.5 x 20e-6 = 1.0e-5 m3 = 10 cm3 m = rho V = 8.9 x 10 = 89 g

Step 2 - Faraday for the time

m = M I t eta/(n F) -> t = m n F/(M I eta) t = 89 x 2 x 96500/(58.7 x 150 x 0.95) t = 17177000/8365 = 2053 s

Step 3 - in minutes, and a check

2053/60 = 34.2 min check with the rate: 300 A/m2 x 34.2 min = 11.7 micron per 20 min, so 20 micron needs 34 min - the two routes agree
150 A, 89 g of nickel, 34 minutes

The 150 A is 5 A per square decimetre, which is a normal nickel bath. If the job must be faster, the answer is not more current - a higher current density burns the deposit, gives a dull, brittle, nodular film - but a bigger bath or two anodes and a rotating fixture.

Check your answer. Keep the units straight: M in kg/mol with m in kg, or M in g/mol with m in g - mixing them is a factor of a thousand. 89 g is right for 10 cm3 of nickel.

પ્રશ્ન (7 marks)

h.en: Corrosion rate from a mass loss

body.en:
Question (7 marks)

A steel coupon 50 mm x 25 mm x 3 mm is exposed for 90 days and loses 1.2 g. Taking rho 7.85 g/cm3, find the corrosion rate in mm per year and the wall it would lose in 10 years.

Step 1 - the exposed area and the time

A = 2(50x25 + 50x3 + 25x3) = 2(1250 + 150 + 75) = 2950 mm2 = 29.5 cm2 t = 90 x 24 = 2160 h

Step 2 - the rate

CR = 87.6 W/(rho A t) with W in mg CR = 87.6 x 1200/(7.85 x 29.5 x 2160) CR = 105120/500239 = 0.21 mm per year

Step 3 - and over ten years

loss = 0.21 x 10 = 2.1 mm
0.21 mm per year, so 2.1 mm of wall in 10 years

Two millimetres on a 6 mm pipe wall is the difference between a serviceable line and a leak. That is why a corrosion rate is always quoted as a thickness per year and never as a mass loss: the drawing is in millimetres.

Check your answer. The formula needs W in milligrams, A in square centimetres and t in hours: 1.2 g is 1200 mg and 29.5 cm2 is not 2950.

h.en: The zinc anode that protects a tank

body.en:
Question (7 marks)

A steel water tank has 2.5 m2 of wetted surface and is protected at a current density of 20 mA/m2 for 2 years. For zinc M 65.4 and n 2, and an anode utilisation of 90 %, find the zinc that is consumed and the anode mass to fit.

Step 1 - the current and the time

I = 20e-3 x 2.5 = 0.050 A t = 2 x 365 x 24 x 3600 = 6.31e7 s

Step 2 - Faraday for the zinc

m = M I t/(n F) = 65.4 x 0.050 x 6.31e7/(2 x 96500) m = 2.06e8/193000 = 1069 g = 1.07 kg

Step 3 - the anode to fit

at 90 % utilisation: 1.07/0.90 = 1.19 kg a 2 kg anode therefore covers the two years with a margin
0.050 A, 1.07 kg of zinc consumed, a 2 kg anode fitted

This is cathodic protection in its simplest form: the zinc is the anode of a cell whose cathode is the whole tank, so the tank cannot corrode at all while a scrap of zinc remains. The same sum with an impressed current replaces the zinc with a rectifier and a inert anode.

Check your answer. Convert years to seconds before Faraday, and remember that only 90 % of the anode actually dissolves usefully - the rest is the part that corrodes away holding the bracket.

પ્રશ્ન (7 marks)

પગલું 1 - current અને સમય

I = 20e-3 x 2.5 = 0.050 A t = 2 x 365 x 24 x 3600 = 6.31e7 s

પગલું 2 - zinc માટે Faraday

m = M I t/(n F) = 65.4 x 0.050 x 6.31e7/(2 x 96500) m = 2.06e8/193000 = 1069 g = 1.07 kg

પગલું 3 - લગાવવાનો anode

at 90 % utilisation: 1.07/0.90 = 1.19 kg a 2 kg anode therefore covers the two years with a margin

આ cathodic protection નું સાદું સ્વરૂપ છે: zinc એ cell નો anode છે જેનો cathode આખી ટાંકી છે, તેથી zinc જ્યાં સુધી બાકી છે ત્યાં સુધી ટાંકી કાટ ખાઈ શકે નહીં. એ જ ગણતરી impressed current સાથે zinc ને rectifier અને inert anode થી બદલે.

Z = nu + 0.7; Y = log10(log10 Z); T in kelvin 40 C: Z = 68.7, log10 Z = 1.83696, Y = 0.26406, log10 T = 2.49575 100 C: Z = 9.3, log10 Z = 0.96848, Y = -0.01391, log10 T = 2.57188

Step 2 - the two constants

B = (0.26406 + 0.01391)/(2.57188 - 2.49575) = 0.27797/0.07613 = 3.651 A = 0.26406 + 3.651 x 2.49575 = 9.377

Step 3 - the viscosity at 60 C

log10 T = log10(333.15) = 2.52258 Y = 9.377 - 3.651 x 2.52258 = 0.1667 log10 Z = 10^0.1667 = 1.4679 -> Z = 29.4 -> nu = 28.7 cSt
28.7 cSt at 60 C, from 68 cSt at 40 C

The viscosity falls by 58 % over 20 K, which is normal for a mineral oil of VI about 100. That is why a pump is selected for the viscosity it will see at its running temperature and why a cold start is the case that decides the pipe size: at 30 C the same oil is near 300 cSt and needs a much bigger suction line.

Check your answer. A sanity check is always available: the answer at 60 C must lie between 8.6 and 68 cSt, and nearer the low end because viscosity falls fast. 28.7 satisfies both.
body.gu:
પ્રશ્ન (6 marks)

એક તેલ 40 C પર 68 cSt અને 100 C પર 8.6 cSt છે. Walther સમીકરણ વાપરીને 60 C ના ચાલુ તાપમાને તેની viscosity શોધો, અને આ ઘટાડો pump માટે શું અર્થ ધરાવે તે કહો.

પગલું 1 - બે બિંદુ Walther સ્વરૂપમાં

Z = nu + 0.7; Y = log10(log10 Z); T in kelvin 40 C: Z = 68.7, log10 Z = 1.83696, Y = 0.26406, log10 T = 2.49575 100 C: Z = 9.3, log10 Z = 0.96848, Y = -0.01391, log10 T = 2.57188

પગલું 2 - બે અચળાંક

B = (0.26406 + 0.01391)/(2.57188 - 2.49575) = 0.27797/0.07613 = 3.651 A = 0.26406 + 3.651 x 2.49575 = 9.377

પગલું 3 - 60 C પર viscosity

log10 T = log10(333.15) = 2.52258 Y = 9.377 - 3.651 x 2.52258 = 0.1667 log10 Z = 10^0.1667 = 1.4679 -> Z = 29.4 -> nu = 28.7 cSt
28.7 cSt at 60 C, from 68 cSt at 40 C

20 K માં viscosity 58 % ઘટે, જે VI લગભગ 100 વાળા ખનીજ તેલ માટે સામાન્ય છે. તેથી pump તેની ચાલુ તાપમાનની viscosity માટે પસંદ થાય અને ઠંડી શરૂઆત જ પાઇપનું માપ નક્કી કરે: 30 C પર એ જ તેલ લગભગ 300 cSt હોય અને ઘણી મોટી suction લાઇન માંગે.

જવાબ ચકાસો. ચકાસણી હંમેશા શક્ય છે: 60 C નો જવાબ 8.6 અને 68 cSt વચ્ચે હોવો જોઈએ, અને નીચેની ધારની નજીક, કારણ કે viscosity ઝડપથી ઘટે. 28.7 બંને પૂરા કરે.

h.en: How much paint for a hundred and twenty square metres
h.gu: સો વીસ ચોરસ મીટર માટે કેટલો પેન્ટ

body.en:
Question (6 marks)

A steel structure of 120 m2 is to have a zinc-rich primer at 75 micron dry film. The paint is 60 % solids by volume at 1.4 kg per litre, application loss is 15 % and it costs Rs 450 a litre. Find the wet film thickness, the litres and kilograms to buy, and the paint cost.

Step 1 - wet film and volume

WFT = 75 x 100/60 = 125 micron V = 120 x 125e-6 = 0.015 m3 = 15 L

Step 2 - with the application loss

15 x 1.15 = 17.25 L, so 18 L are bought m = 17.25 x 1.4 = 24.2 kg

Step 3 - the money

cost = 17.25 x 450 = Rs 7,763
125 micron wet, 17.25 litres, 24.2 kg, Rs 7,763 of paint

The 15 % loss is not a mistake in the sum, it is part of the method: 5 % stays in the tin and the pump, 5 % is overspray and 5 % is lost on edges and welds where the film cannot be controlled. A specification that ignores it runs out of paint on the last two metres.

Check your answer. Coverage is a quick cross-check: 10 x 60/75 = 8 m2 per litre, and 120/8 = 15 litres without loss. Two independent routes, the same 15 litres.
body.gu:
પ્રશ્ન (6 marks)

120 m2 ના સ્ટીલ ઢાંચા પર 75 માઇક્રોમીટર સૂકી ફિલ્મનો zinc ભરપૂર primer ચઢાવવાનો છે. પેન્ટમાં volume પ્રમાણે 60 % solids, લિટર દીઠ 1.4 kg, ચઢાવતાં 15 % વ્યય અને લિટરનો ભાવ Rs 450 છે. ભીની ફિલ્મની જાડાઈ, ખરીદવાના લિટર અને કિલો, અને પેન્ટનો ખર્ચ શોધો.

પગલું 1 - ભીની ફિલ્મ અને ઘનફળ

WFT = 75 x 100/60 = 125 micron V = 120 x 125e-6 = 0.015 m3 = 15 L

પગલું 2 - ચઢાવવાના વ્યય સાથે

15 x 1.15 = 17.25 L, so 18 L are bought m = 17.25 x 1.4 = 24.2 kg

પગલું 3 - પૈસા

cost = 17.25 x 450 = Rs 7,763
125 micron wet, 17.25 litres, 24.2 kg, Rs 7,763 of paint

15 % વ્યય ગણતરીની ભૂલ નથી, પદ્ધતિનો ભાગ છે: 5 % ડબ્બા અને pump માં રહે, 5 % overspray જાય અને 5 % ધાર તથી welds પર જાય જ્યાં ફિલ્મ નિયંત્રિત ન થાય. જે specification તેને ગણે નહીં તે છેલ્લા બે મીટરમાં પેન્ટ વગર રહે.

જવાબ ચકાસો. Coverage ઝડપી ચકાસણી છે: 10 x 60/75 = લિટર દીઠ 8 m2, અને વ્યય વગર 120/8 = 15 લિટર. બે અલગ રસ્તા, એ જ 15 લિટર.

h.en: Does a six millimetre pipe last twelve years

body.en:
Question (6 marks)

A cooling water line is 6.0 mm wall plain carbon steel with a minimum allowable wall of 4.5 mm. The measured corrosion rate is 0.25 mm per year. Find the life of the line, the wall needed for a 12 year life, and one alternative.

Step 1 - the metal available

available = 6.0 - 4.5 = 1.5 mm

Step 2 - the life

life = 1.5/0.25 = 6 years

Step 3 - the wall for twelve years, and an alternative

allowance needed = 0.25 x 12 = 3.0 mm -> wall 4.5 + 3.0 = 7.5 mm or keep 6.0 mm and bring the rate below 1.5/12 = 0.125 mm/year a coating or an inhibitor is what buys that half rate
6 years as it stands, 7.5 mm wall for 12 years, or halve the corrosion rate

Every line like this is a choice between three costs: a thicker wall once, a treatment that is maintained for ever, or a replacement in six years. The calculation is not the hard part; the hard part is that the rate must be measured where the line actually runs, because a cooling line corrodes eight times faster at a weld than in the straight.

Check your answer. The minimum wall is a code number, not a preference: the 4.5 mm is what the line needs at the design pressure, so the corrosion allowance is added on top of it and never taken out of it.
body.gu:
પ્રશ્ન (6 marks)

કૂલિંગ વોટર લાઇનની દીવાલ 6.0 mm સાદું carbon steel છે અને લઘુતમ માન્ય દીવાલ 4.5 mm છે. માપેલો corrosion rate 0.25 mm પ્રતિ વર્ષ છે. લાઇનનું આયુષ્ય, 12 વર્ષ માટે જરૂરી દીવાલ, અને એક વિકલ્પ શોધો.

પગલું 1 - ઉપલબ્ધ ધાતુ

available = 6.0 - 4.5 = 1.5 mm

પગલું 2 - આયુષ્ય

life = 1.5/0.25 = 6 years

પગલું 3 - 12 વર્ષ માટે દીવાલ, અને વિકલ્પ

allowance needed = 0.25 x 12 = 3.0 mm -> wall 4.5 + 3.0 = 7.5 mm or keep 6.0 mm and bring the rate below 1.5/12 = 0.125 mm/year a coating or an inhibitor is what buys that half rate
6 years as it stands, 7.5 mm wall for 12 years, or halve the corrosion rate

આવી દરેક લાઇન ત્રણ ખર્ચ વચ્ચેની પસંદગી છે: એક વાર જાડી દીવાલ, કાયમ જાળવવી પડતી સારવાર, કે છ વર્ષે બદલી. ગણતરી કઠિન ભાગ નથી; કઠિન ભાગ એ છે કે દર ત્યાં માપવો પડે જ્યાં લાઇન ખરેખર ચાલે, કારણ કે કૂલિંગ લાઇન weld પર સીધા ભાગ કરતાં આઠ ગણી ઝડપથી કાટ ખાય.

જવાબ ચકાસો. લઘુતમ દીવાલ code નો આંકડો છે, પસંદગી નહીં: 4.5 mm design pressure પર લાઇનને જોઈએ તેટલું છે, તેથી corrosion allowance તેની ઉપર ઉમેરાય, તેમાંથી કદી બાદ ન થાય.

caption.en: The coating, the treated zone beneath it and the untouched bulk: a part fails at the surface because that is where the stress, the wear and the environment meet.
caption.gu: કોટિંગ, તેની નીચેનો સારવાર પામેલો ઝોન અને અડક્યા વગરનો bulk: ભાગ સપાટી પર નિષ્ફળ જાય કારણ કે ત્યાં stress, ઘસારો અને પર્યાવરણ મળે છે.

title.en: Surface finish and what it costs

caption.en: Drilling at 6.3 micron to lapping at 0.05 micron, each step buying a quarter of the roughness - and none of it working unless the surface is clean first.
caption.gu: 6.3 માઇક્રોમીટર drilling થી 0.05 માઇક્રોમીટર lapping સુધી, દરેક પગલું આધી ખરબચડાઈ ખરીદે - અને સપાટી પહેલાં સાફ ન હોય તો કંઈ જ કામ ન કરે.

caption.en: The anode dissolves into the electrolyte and the work as cathode grows the same metal back, one Faraday at a time: 300 A/m2 for twenty minutes is 11.7 micron of nickel.
caption.gu: Anode electrolyte માં ઓગળે અને કામ cathode તરીકે એ જ ધાતુ પાછી ઉગાડે, એક Faraday વખતે: 300 A/m2 વીસ મિનિટ એટલે 11.7 માઇક્રોમીટર nickel.

title.gu: કોટિંગની જાડાઈ એક જ માપદંડ પર

caption.en: A PVD film at 3 micron protects a cutting edge, a paint system at 220 micron protects a bridge, and hot dip zinc at 80 micron protects by being consumed, not by being hard.
caption.gu: 3 માઇક્રોમીટરની PVD ફિલ્મ cutting edge રક્ષે, 220 માઇક્રોમીટરનું પેન્ટ પુલ રક્ષે, અને 80 માઇક્રોમીટરનું hot dip zinc સખત હોવાથી નહીં, ખર્ચાઈને રક્ષે.

caption.en: Two oils that are both 10 cSt at 100 C: at 30 C one is 110 cSt and the other 316, and that difference is what the viscosity index measures.
caption.gu: બંને તેલ 100 C પર 10 cSt: 30 C પર એક 110 cSt અને બીજું 316, અને એ જ ફરક viscosity index માપે છે.

caption.en: Four coats on a blasted plate, each with its own job, and a total dry film of 215 micron that only works if every coat keyed to the one below it.
caption.gu: Blasted પ્લેટ પર ચાર કોટ, દરેકનું પોતાનું કામ, અને કુલ 215 માઇક્રોમીટર સૂકી ફિલ્મ જે ત્યારે જ ચાલે જ્યારે દરેક કોટ નીચેના કોટ સાથે પકડાય.

caption.en: An anode, a cathode, an electrolyte and a path: steel rusts where the oxygen arrives and the metal gives up electrons, and 0.1 A/m2 costs 0.116 mm a year.
caption.gu: Anode, cathode, electrolyte અને રસ્તો: જ્યાં oxygen આવે અને ધાતુ electrons આપે ત્યાં સ્ટીલ કાટ ખાય, અને 0.1 A/m2 એટલે વર્ષે 0.116 mm.

caption.en: Uniform, galvanic, pitting, crevice, stress cracking and erosion: only the first can be paid for with a corrosion allowance, so the other five have to be designed out.
caption.gu: Uniform, galvanic, pitting, crevice, stress cracking અને erosion: ફક્ત પહેલાને corrosion allowance થી ચૂકવી શકાય, તેથી બાકીના પાંચ design થી જ દૂર કરવા પડે.

terms.en: M is the molar mass, n the electrons per ion and F 96500 C/mol, so a coulomb always deposits the same mass.
terms.gu: M એ molar mass, n એ ion દીઠ electrons અને F 96500 C/mol, તેથી એક કૂલમ્બ હંમેશા એ જ દળ જમા કરે.

items.f: t = M i t_sec eta/(n F rho)

terms.en: 300 A/m2 of nickel at 95 % efficiency for 20 min gives 11.7 micron.
terms.gu: 95 % efficiency પર 300 A/m2 nickel 20 મિનિટમાં 11.7 માઇક્રોમીટર આપે.

items.f: m(1 A h) = 3600 M/(n F) = 1.095 g for nickel

terms.en: The number a plating shop keeps in its head: 1.095 g/Ah for nickel, 1.22 for copper, 6.86 for zinc.
terms.gu: Plating દુકાન યાદ રાખે તે આંકડો: nickel 1.095 g/Ah, copper 1.22, zinc 6.86.

terms.en: 75 micron dry at 60 % solids means 125 micron wet, and that is what the gauge is laid on.
terms.gu: 60 % solids પર 75 માઇક્રોમીટર સૂકી એટલે 125 માઇક્રોમીટર ભીની, અને ગેજ એ જ માપે.

terms.en: 0.1 A per m2 on steel is 0.116 mm a year - the same Faraday law, running backwards.
terms.gu: સ્ટીલ પર 0.1 A પ્રતિ m2 એટલે વર્ષે 0.116 mm - એ જ Faraday નિયમ, ઊલટો ચાલે છે.

terms.en: W in mg, A in cm2, t in hours and rho in g/cm3: 1.2 g from 29.5 cm2 in 90 days is 0.21 mm/year.
terms.gu: W mg માં, A cm2 માં, t કલાકમાં અને rho g/cm3 માં: 29.5 cm2 માંથી 90 દિવસમાં 1.2 g એટલે વર્ષે 0.21 mm.

terms.en: 0.25 mm/year over 12 years is 3.0 mm of extra wall, written on the drawing.
terms.gu: 12 વર્ષ માટે 0.25 mm/વર્ષ એટલે 3.0 mm વધારાની દીવાલ, ડ્રોઇંગ પર લખાય.

terms.en: Zinc -0.76 V and copper +0.34 V give 1.10 V; zinc and iron give only 0.32 V.
terms.gu: Zinc -0.76 V અને copper +0.34 V એટલે 1.10 V; zinc અને iron ફક્ત 0.32 V.

terms.en: 0.20 mm/rev over a 0.8 mm nose radius is 1.56 micron; halving the feed quarters the roughness.
terms.gu: 0.8 mm nose radius પર 0.20 mm/rev એટલે 1.56 માઇક્રોમીટર; feed અડધું કરો તો ખરબચડાઈ ચોથા ભાગની.

terms.en: Above 3 the surfaces are fully separated, 1 to 3 is mixed and below 1 is metal contact.
terms.gu: 3 ઉપર સપાટી પૂરી અલગ, 1 થી 3 mixed અને 1 ની નીચે ધાતુ ધાતુને અડે.

terms.en: A drawing in Ra and a gauge in Rz are not the same number; multiply before you argue.
terms.gu: Ra માં ડ્રોઇંગ અને Rz માં ગેજ એક જ આંકડો નથી; દલીલ પહેલાં ગુણો.

terms.en: VG 68 covers 61.2 to 74.8 cSt, which is why two brands of VG 68 are not identical.
terms.gu: VG 68 એટલે 61.2 થી 74.8 cSt, તેથી બે બ્રાન્ડના VG 68 સરખા નથી.

terms.en: U is the oil at 40 C, L and H are reference oils of VI 0 and VI 100 with the same 100 C viscosity.
terms.gu: U એ 40 C પરનું તેલ, L અને H એ સમાન 100 C viscosity વાળા VI 0 અને VI 100 ના સંદર્ભ તેલ.

terms.en: Two measured viscosities fix A and B, and then any other temperature can be calculated.
terms.gu: બે માપેલી viscosity A અને B નક્કી કરે, અને પછી કોઈ પણ તાપમાનની ગણતરી થાય.

terms.en: 120 m2 at 125 micron wet is 0.015 m3, which is 15 litres of paint.
terms.gu: 125 માઇક્રોમીટર ભીની પર 120 m2 એટલે 0.015 m3, એટલે 15 લિટર પેન્ટ.

terms.en: 60 % solids at 75 micron covers 8 m2 per litre, so 120 m2 takes 15 litres.
terms.gu: 75 માઇક્રોમીટર પર 60 % solids લિટર દીઠ 8 m2 ઢાંકે, તેથી 120 m2 ને 15 લિટર.

terms.en: 17.25 litres at 1.4 kg/L is 24.2 kg, which is what the store issues.
terms.gu: 1.4 kg/L પર 17.25 લિટર એટલે 24.2 kg, જેટલું સ્ટોર આપે.

q.en: Why does a part usually fail at the surface and not in the middle?
q.gu: ભાગ સામાન્ય રીતે વચ્ચે નહીં, સપાટી પર કેમ નિષ્ફળ જાય?

a.en: Because the bending stress is highest there, the environment only touches there and two sliding parts only meet there: the outer 10 % of the radius already carries 19 % of the moment.
a.gu: કારણ કે ત્યાં bending stress સૌથી વધુ હોય, પર્યાવરણ ફક્ત ત્યાં જ અડે અને સરકતા બે ભાગ ફક્ત ત્યાં મળે: ત્રિજ્યાના બહારના 10 % જ moment ના 19 % ઉપાડે.

q.en: What is the cleaning sequence before a coating, and why is the order fixed?
q.gu: કોટિંગ પહેલાં સફાઈનો ક્રમ શું, અને ક્રમ નિશ્ચિત કેમ?

a.en: Degrease, pickle to remove scale, rinse, blast to a 50 - 75 micron profile and coat the same day. Oil stops the acid from working, so grease must go first, and steel starts to rust again within hours.
a.gu: Degrease, scale કાઢવા pickle, rinse, 50 - 75 માઇક્રોમીટર profile સુધી blast અને એ જ દિવસે કોટ. તેલ એસિડને કામ કરવા દે નહીં, તેથી grease પહેલાં જવું પડે, અને સ્ટીલ થોડા કલાકમાં ફરી કાટ ખાવા લાગે.

q.en: Why does a paint specification give a blast profile in microns?
q.gu: પેન્ટની specification blast profile માઇક્રોમીટરમાં કેમ આપે?

a.en: Because the paint keys into the profile mechanically, like a key in a lock. A polished surface gives nothing to grip and a coarse one leaves peaks that the film cannot cover, so 50 - 75 micron is specified.
a.gu: કારણ કે પેન્ટ profile માં યાંત્રિક રીતે પકડાય, ચાવી તાળામાં જેમ. ચળકતી સપાટી પકડવા કંઈ આપતી નથી અને જાડી સપાટી એવી ટોચ છોડે જે ફિલ્મ ઢાંકી શકે નહીં, તેથી 50 - 75 માઇક્રોમીટર લખાય.

q.en: How does electroplating deposit a metal on to a part?
q.gu: Electroplating ભાગ પર ધાતુ કેમ જમા કરે?

a.en: The part is the cathode in a bath of the metal's own salt and a plate of that metal is the anode. Metal dissolves at the anode, crosses as an ion and is reduced on the part; Faraday's law gives the mass.
a.gu: ભાગ એ ધાતુના પોતાના ક્ષારના સ્નાનમાં cathode છે અને એ ધાતુની પ્લેટ anode. ધાતુ anode પર ઓગળે, ion તરીકે પસાર થાય અને ભાગ પર reduce થાય; Faraday નો નિયમ દળ આપે.

q.en: What is the difference between a sacrificial and a barrier coating?
q.gu: Sacrificial અને barrier કોટિંગમાં શું ફરક?

a.en: Zinc is sacrificial: it corrodes in place of the steel, so it still protects a scratched area. Nickel, chrome and paint are barriers: they protect only while they are continuous, and a scratch is a failure.
a.gu: Zinc sacrificial છે: સ્ટીલને બદલે પોતે કાટ ખાય, તેથી ખરોચેલા ભાગને પણ રક્ષે. Nickel, chrome અને પેન્ટ barrier છે: જ્યાં સુધી સતત હોય ત્યાં સુધી રક્ષે, અને ખરોચ એ નિષ્ફળતા છે.

q.en: Why is PVD used on a cutting tool and not on a large steel structure?
q.gu: PVD cutting tool પર કેમ વપરાય, મોટા સ્ટીલ ઢાંચા પર નહીં?

a.en: PVD makes a very hard, very thin film of 1 - 5 micron at under 500 C, but it is line of sight and needs a vacuum chamber, so it suits a small, high-value tool and not a bridge.
a.gu: PVD 500 C ની નીચે 1 - 5 માઇક્રોમીટરની ખૂબ સખત, ખૂબ પાતળી ફિલ્મ બનાવે, પણ તે line of sight છે અને vacuum chamber જોઈએ, તેથી નાના, મોંઘા tool ને શોભે, પુલને નહીં.

q.en: What does the viscosity index of an oil tell you?
q.gu: તેલનો viscosity index શું કહે છે?

a.en: How little its viscosity falls when it is heated. Two oils can both be 10 cSt at 100 C, but at 30 C one is 110 cSt and the other 316 cSt, and the high-VI oil keeps the film at running temperature.
a.gu: ગરમ થતાં તેની viscosity કેટલી ઓછી ઘટે છે તે. બે તેલ 100 C પર 10 cSt હોઈ શકે, પણ 30 C પર એક 110 cSt અને બીજું 316 cSt, અને ઊંચા VI વાળું તેલ ચાલુ તાપમાને ફિલ્મ રાખે.

q.en: Why is an oil grade quoted at 40 C and not at room temperature?
q.gu: તેલનો grade 40 C પર કેમ લખાય, રૂમ તાપમાને નહીં?

a.en: Because 40 C is close to the running temperature of most industrial machines and it is reproducible in a viscometer, so the grade means the same on every drum in every country.
a.gu: કારણ કે 40 C મોટા ભાગનાં ઔદ્યોગિક મશીનોના ચાલુ તાપમાનની નજીક છે અને viscometer માં પુનરાવર્તિત થાય, તેથી grade દરેક દેશના દરેક ડ્રમ પર એક જ અર્થ આપે.

q.en: What does an anti-wear additive such as ZDDP actually do?
q.gu: ZDDP જેવું anti-wear additive ખરેખર શું કરે?

a.en: It reacts at the hot spots where asperities touch and builds a thin sacrificial film of sulphide and phosphate, so the two surfaces slide on the film instead of shearing each other.
a.gu: તે એ ગરમ જગ્યાએ react કરે જ્યાં asperities અડે અને sulphide તથી phosphate ની પાતળી બલિદાન ફિલ્મ બનાવે, તેથી બે સપાટી એકબીજા પર કાપવાને બદલે ફિલ્મ પર સરકે.

q.en: What are the four things a corrosion cell needs?
q.gu: Corrosion cell ને કઈ ચાર વસ્તુ જોઈએ?

a.en: An anode that dissolves, a cathode that consumes electrons, an electrolyte to carry the ions and a metallic path for the electrons. Remove any one and the corrosion stops.
a.gu: ઓગળતો anode, electrons વાપરતો cathode, ions લઈ જતું electrolyte અને electrons માટે ધાતુનો રસ્તો. એક પણ દૂર કરો તો કાટ અટકે.

q.en: Why does stainless steel pit in sea water?
q.gu: Stainless steel દરિયાના પાણીમાં pitting કેમ ખાય?

a.en: Its protection is a passive chromium oxide film a few atoms thick. Chloride breaks that film locally and stops it re-forming, so the attack goes in deep at one point instead of spreading.
a.gu: તેનું રક્ષણ થોડા atoms જાડી passive chromium oxide ફિલ્મ છે. Chloride એ ફિલ્મ સ્થાનિક રીતે તોડે અને ફરી બનવા દે નહીં, તેથી હુમલો ફેલાવાને બદલે એક જગ્યાએ ઊંડો જાય.

q.en: What do the primer and the topcoat each do?
q.gu: Primer અને topcoat દરેક શું કરે?

a.en: The primer sticks to the blast and carries the inhibitive pigment that keeps the steel passive where the film is damaged; the topcoat carries the colour and resists UV and rain, so it protects the primer.
a.gu: Primer blast સાથે ચોંટે અને inhibitive pigment ધરાવે જે ફિલ્મ બગડ્યાં જ્યાં સ્ટીલને passive રાખે; topcoat રંગ ધરાવે અને UV તથી વરસાદ સામે ટકે, તેથી primer ને રક્ષે.

q.en: A steel panel of 0.5 m2 is to be nickel plated to 20 micron. The current density is 300 A/m2, the cathode efficiency is 95 %, and for nickel M 58.7, n 2 and rho 8.9 g/cm3. Find the current, the mass of nickel needed and the plating time.
q.gu: 0.5 m2 ના સ્ટીલ પેનલ પર 20 માઇક્રોમીટર nickel plating કરવાનું છે. Current density 300 A/m2, cathode efficiency 95 %, અને nickel માટે M 58.7, n 2 તથી rho 8.9 g/cm3. Current, જરૂરી nickel નું દળ અને plating નો સમય શોધો.

q.en: A steel coupon 50 mm x 25 mm x 3 mm is exposed for 90 days and loses 1.2 g. Taking rho 7.85 g/cm3, find the corrosion rate in mm per year and the wall it would lose in 10 years.
q.gu: 50 mm x 25 mm x 3 mm નો સ્ટીલ coupon 90 દિવસ રાખ્યા પછી 1.2 g ગુમાવે છે. rho 7.85 g/cm3 લઈને mm પ્રતિ વર્ષમાં corrosion rate અને 10 વર્ષમાં જતી દીવાલ શોધો.

q.en: A steel water tank has 2.5 m2 of wetted surface and is protected at a current density of 20 mA/m2 for 2 years. For zinc M 65.4 and n 2, and an anode utilisation of 90 %, find the zinc that is consumed and the anode mass to fit.
q.gu: સ્ટીલની પાણીની ટાંકીની ભીની સપાટી 2.5 m2 છે અને તેને 20 mA/m2 ના current density પર 2 વર્ષ રક્ષવાની છે. Zinc માટે M 65.4 અને n 2, અને anode નો 90 % ઉપયોગ લઈને ખર્ચાતું zinc અને લગાવવાનો anode દળ શોધો.

q.en: An oil has 68 cSt at 40 C and 8.6 cSt at 100 C. Use the Walther equation to find its viscosity at the running temperature of 60 C, and say what the drop means for the pump.
q.gu: એક તેલ 40 C પર 68 cSt અને 100 C પર 8.6 cSt છે. Walther સમીકરણ વાપરીને 60 C ના ચાલુ તાપમાને તેની viscosity શોધો, અને આ ઘટાડો pump માટે શું અર્થ ધરાવે તે કહો.

q.en: A steel structure of 120 m2 is to have a zinc-rich primer at 75 micron dry film. The paint is 60 % solids by volume at 1.4 kg per litre, application loss is 15 % and it costs Rs 450 a litre. Find the wet film thickness, the litres and kilograms to buy, and the paint cost.
q.gu: 120 m2 ના સ્ટીલ ઢાંચા પર 75 માઇક્રોમીટર સૂકી ફિલ્મનો zinc ભરપૂર primer ચઢાવવાનો છે. પેન્ટમાં volume પ્રમાણે 60 % solids, લિટર દીઠ 1.4 kg, ચઢાવતાં 15 % વ્યય અને લિટરનો ભાવ Rs 450 છે. ભીની ફિલ્મની જાડાઈ, ખરીદવાના લિટર અને કિલો, અને પેન્ટનો ખર્ચ શોધો.

q.en: A cooling water line is 6.0 mm wall plain carbon steel with a minimum allowable wall of 4.5 mm. The measured corrosion rate is 0.25 mm per year. Find the life of the line, the wall needed for a 12 year life, and one alternative.
q.gu: કૂલિંગ વોટર લાઇનની દીવાલ 6.0 mm સાદું carbon steel છે અને લઘુતમ માન્ય દીવાલ 4.5 mm છે. માપેલો corrosion rate 0.25 mm પ્રતિ વર્ષ છે. લાઇનનું આયુષ્ય, 12 વર્ષ માટે જરૂરી દીવાલ, અને એક વિકલ્પ શોધો.

learning_outcomes.gu: Surface properties સુધારવા electrolysis, paints/varnish અને corrosion સમજાવવું.
